title: Apex Charts
summary: Showcase of ApexCharts library with 12 chart cards in a 2-column grid. Includes area chart, line chart with markers, scatter plot, bar/column chart, horizontal bar chart, candlestick chart, heatmap, radial bar/gauge, radar chart, donut chart, and pie chart. Each chart sits inside a v-card with a title header.

layout.columns: 2-column grid, some charts span full width
